newsitem.title: USA: AMR nets $592 mln from Sabre IPO.
newsitem.headline: AMR nets $592 mln from Sabre IPO.

text.p: AMR Corp said it gained $592 million in net proceeds from the initial public offering of its Sabre Group Holdings Inc unit.
AMR spun off about 16 percent of its reservation and information systems unit in a public offering on October 11.
AMR's chief financial officer Gerard Arpey said the company will use 90 percent of the proceeds to repay indebtedness, while the remaining 10 percent will be used for general corporate purposes.
The company, the parent of American Airlines, now has about $13 billion in total debt, Arpey said during a teleconference with reporters.
